name: g4.ConvertScreenshotPoint
title: Convert A Screenshot Point
description: Converts one raw pixel selected on a g4.GetScreenshot image into source-image and physical desktop pixels using the recorder's deterministic image layout and current metrics. Supply only the copied one-based imageNumber, x, and y; the recorder owns dimensions, scaling, origin, DPI, and physical-coordinate conversion.

imageNumber.description: One-based number copied from the metadata immediately preceding the exact g4.GetScreenshot image containing the selected pixel.

x.description: Horizontal pixel selected on the exact g4.GetScreenshot image identified by imageNumber.

y.description: Vertical pixel selected on the exact g4.GetScreenshot image identified by imageNumber.
